findings.quote: Product response sends noindex despite Google indexing intent
findings.rationale: Explicit public Google indexing intent conflicts with captured noindex header; no observed index outcome asserted.

findings.quote: Old and new routes redirect to one another

findings.quote: Machine-readable offer price conflicts with approved visible price
findings.rationale: Approved USD29 and encoded USD19 refer to same market and time; fix scoped to offer, eligibility separate.

findings.quote: Product and guide disagree about the current Starter entitlement
findings.rationale: Same plan/version/monthly storage amounts conflict; authoritative amount left unresolved.

findings.quote: Vietnamese draft overpromises free ticket changes
findings.rationale: Complete Vietnamese draft contradicts both Member-only free change eligibility and minimum24-hour notice; unknown fees remain unknown.
